1.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
1.asv: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

2.web: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
2.asv: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

3.web: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
3.asv: Considerand answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

4.web: Lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him”; Lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
4.asv: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.

5.web: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
5.asv: But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

6.web: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
6.asv: I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
